items.text: Phase A/B above: every feature x role x 12 journey types, plus secondary journeys
Every number shown (dues, counts, dates, streaks, records, credits) is recomputed independently and compared
rounding
time zone (IST)
duplicates on double tap / two devices
import and undo-import
what happens to old data after every migration
Also: AI answers (assistant, AI import, AI questions, coach): built only from that gym's real data
Also: AI answers (assistant, AI import, AI questions, coach): what a wrong answer costs the owner
Also: AI answers (assistant, AI import, AI questions, coach): what is sent to the AI company
Every server route and RPC: who can call it, with what role
row-level rules per table: read every policy from the catalog and the existing database tests in supabase/tests, and for each table state which test proves another gym is refused
a table with no such test = finding
A live cross-gym attempt is NOT run in this audit
secrets in code or in the public repo or in the APK
key exposure (e.g. AI key inside the APK, no spend cap)
session expiry, PIN reset, sign-in brute force
injection in every text box
uploads
links that can be guessed (/j/<code>, gym pages)
Dependency CVEs (npm audit, Gradle)
Promise register (A7)
India DPDP Act duties (notice, consent, purpose, deletion, breach timing, children)
who at MettleUp can see gym data and the record of it (read log)
data kept longer than promised
data sent to outside services (AI, WhatsApp, analytics, Health Connect / Google Health / Fitbit) vs what the policy says
account deletion really deletes everywhere (backups noted)
Every price, plan, trial, founding offer, Play Billing / payment flow, refund, receipt, GST wording, credits wallet
test mode vs live
what happens on failed, pending, refunded, cancelled, expired
amounts match across panel, HQ, receipts and messages
Offline and bad network on every write
retries do not double-save
outages of each outside service (Supabase, Cloudflare, Play, WhatsApp, AI): what the user sees
backups exist and a restore was tested
cron jobs that fail silently
error logging (every "try again" logs why)

Every recording or timer that runs over time (heart rate, rest timer, workout clock, sync) keeps working in every device state: screen on, dim / always-on, off, app in the background, watch off the wrist
where cloud emulators cannot show it, prove it by reading the code
Panel load on a slow Indian 4G phone (Core Web Vitals)
biggest pages and lists with 500+ members
phone app start time, workout screen with long history
watch battery and screen-on time
database queries without indexes
Every paid or capped thing: Supabase free-plan limits (DB size, egress, log retention), Cloudflare limits, GitHub storage, AI spend per gym and per call with no cap, WhatsApp template cost
what happens at each limit
a usage alarm before each one
Screen reader labels, tap target size, contrast in dark and light, largest font, no meaning by colour only, keyboard use on the panel
Every tappable thing LOOKS tappable (read the screenshot as a first-time user)
every pop-up that can be closed leaves a way back to what it offered
Every user string in English and Hinglish: plain, true, consistent names for the same thing, no inside words, no banned words, no claims that are not live, Hindi read-aloud list for him
Every alert, push, WhatsApp, email: when it fires, to whom, on/off switch, sound on each phone maker (OPPO etc.), screen off, quiet hours, duplicates, "done means gone", watch bridging
Play policy (target API, billing, data safety form matches the real app, permissions justified, ads/health claims), Wear OS rules, Meta/WhatsApp rules, ASCI ad rules
App Store when iPhone ships
Also: rights to what we ship: exercise pictures and clips, music, voices, fonts, icons, open-source licences, the MettleUp name and logo
Fresh install, update over every older version still in use, data migration on update, sideload vs Play package, watch and phone on different versions, panel cache after deploy (old page still open)
How a gym is set up, moved (data import), helped (support window), billed, and offboarded
what the owner (you) does each day
help articles match the screens
every "contact us" path reaches someone
Also: keys, accounts and the one-person risk: every account, domain, signing key and token: who holds it, when it expires, what breaks if the laptop is lost, is there a written way back in
For every S1/S2 failure type: would we know before a gym tells us?
Error reports, crash reports, job failure alerts, a daily health line
Also: product measurement: which sign-up, activation, day-30 and paid numbers exist, and which decisions are made blind
Dead code, duplicated logic (two scorers, two date rules), silent catches, tests that check nothing, frozen areas, files no test touches
flaky tests
The same fact, word, colour, icon and rule is the same on panel, phone, watch, website and messages
Trace every value a user enters on one device (watch, phone, panel) to every place that should hold it (the other device, the saved record, the server, Health Connect): it arrives unchanged and stays
where a paired device cannot run in the cloud, trace it in the code

Per surface: extra taps to remove, missing states, what the top 3 apps in the category do better (named sources, dated), features members/owners ask for (feedback, enquiries), growth loops (referral, recommend-to-gym), store listing and website conversion
Write as "My view:" proposals, never built without his yes
A member, staff or outsider trying to cheat: fake check-ins, editing dues, scraping join links, spamming enquiries, using a gym's AI credits, sharing a Pro feature
Also: AI injection: can text typed by a member or lead steer the AI
Trial end, plan end, gym pauses or closes, member leaves and returns, staff leaves (access removed), owner changes phone, year end, leap day, app not opened for 6 months
List every setting, switch, plan gate, status and automation (from features.json + entities.json)
For EACH one, list every other feature whose result it SHOULD change (the AI ideas, Today, counts, badges, reminders, messages, help, exports, the phone app)
Then check in code that each of those really reads it
A should-read with no read = finding

For every automatic or "on" feature: write ALL conditions for it to reach one person (app installed, app linked by proven number, notifications allowed, phone maker rules, plan running, data filled in like birthday/phone, feature switch, version)
Then check: can the owner SEE, per member, who will get it and who will not, and why?
If the switch says "on" but some people silently get nothing = finding
Count real reach on Crispy Curves (e.g. "birthday wish: on, reaches 1 of 40 members")

Where reaching the person depends on the phone or the watch itself (phone maker sound, banner and battery rules that can change what the app asked for, a paired watch the phone must detect, a version check between phone and watch): mark that path "cannot be proven in the cloud, needs a real-phone check" and name what to look at on the device
Every automatic send, reminder, push, digest, job: is there a record the owner (or HQ) can open that says it went, to whom, when, and why not when it did not?
An automatic action with no record and no "why not" = finding (S2 when the owner believes it ran)
Find every pair of features that act on the same people or the same event (manual message vs automatic reminder; AI idea vs Today nudge; bell vs Today vs push; desk link vs phone proof)
Check they agree: no double message, no suggestion to do what the system already did, the same count in both places, "done" in one is "done" in the other
For every "done", "read" or "seen" mark: find where it is kept (this browser only, this phone only, or the server)
Every other place that counts or sends the same items (a server push or daily summary, another device, another staff member, Today, the bell) must read that same mark
a mark kept in one place while another place still counts the same item as waiting = finding
Also the case where no mark exists at all: every list or count of items that point at a thing to act on (alerts, to-dos, a daily summary)

When that thing is handled in its own page (reply sent, request settled, enquiry closed), does the item leave the list and the count in every place, server sends included, without anyone touching the item itself?
An item that cannot learn its thing was handled = finding
For every feature in features.json: is it on main, deployed, behind a switch, or waiting for a migration?
Compare code on main with what the live panel, HQ, website, phone app (Play version) and database really run (check the live version labels, list_migrations/catalog, switches)
Any feature the notes or What's new call live that is not live = finding
Output docs/system-map/LIVE-STATE.md (one row per feature: main / live panel / live DB / Play app), so he can always see what is really live
For every field a feature depends on (birthday, phone, check-in phone, app link, plan dates, trainer, batch): how many Crispy Curves rows have it filled?
Is there a screen that asks for it at the right moment?
A feature that depends on a field most rows lack = finding

For every input box (mobile number, name, date): feed it what a phone keyboard autofill or a paste really puts in (country code, spaces, dashes, digits in other scripts) and check that the length limit and the cleaning step together keep a valid value
a box that cuts or refuses a real autofill = finding
Every new flow that fixes something only for NEW installs or NEW members (e.g. the phone sign-in shows only on new installs): what happens to existing users?
Is there a path for them?
None = finding
And the reverse: every "new since your last version" mark (dots, What's new, update notices, tips): what does a brand-new install or a brand-new member see?
New marks on things that are not new to them = finding

By script first: docs/system-map/_tools/silent.mjs lists every catch block with file:line and three flags: logs? (calls a log, report or crash function inside), tells_user? (sets an error state, toast or alert inside), rethrows?
Output _sources/silent.csv
Helpers read ONLY the rows where all three are "no", plus every fallback value (?? null, || [], ?? 0) that sits in a file named in a journey that writes money, messages, alerts, sign-in or sync
Everything else is counted in the grid as "filtered by script, N rows, not read" so the gap is visible
For each: if this path runs, does the user (or owner, or HQ) learn anything?
A silent path that hides a failed promise = finding

For each fact a user sees (count of alerts, dues, plan end, birthdays today, members using the app): list every place it shows (panel, Today, AI, bell, push, phone app, HQ, export) and compare the values on the Crispy Curves data and the ugly data pack
Any difference = finding

For every number worked out from dates (not seen for N days, ends in N days, new this week, after a long gap): test the edges (day 0, someone who joined today, a plan that starts later, no visit yet, a gap of weeks)
A number wrong at an edge = finding
For every summary number shown with its own rows (a total, a target, a score): check it is worked out from those same rows, and when it is lower than last time the screen says why
A summary that differs from its rows, or a drop with no reason shown = finding
Open the files that work numbers out (engine, logic, lib, store), not only the screens that draw them
For each number a screen shows above or beside its rows, find the function that makes the number and the function that makes each row
if they are two different functions, compare them on a long-gap case

Every switch label, help article, What's new line and button that says what happens ("Members get a birthday wish", "Done items leave the bell"): read the code path end to end and confirm it happens for EVERY member the words cover
Words wider than reality = finding (tie to the promise register)
Include legal and privacy pages (data agreement, privacy notice, consent and sign-in screens), and check every way into the data, staff and direct database logins included
Every notification, link and button: follow a tap to where it lands
a tap that opens nothing, or a general page instead of the thing it names = finding
Every button that can be greyed out or do nothing: the screen says why, next to it
a disabled or silent button with no reason in view = finding
Every label in every language the app offers (Hinglish runs longer): check in code it can wrap or shrink at 320 to 390 px wide (no fixed no-wrap, no min-width that cannot shrink, no crowded top bar)
text cut off or pushed past the screen edge = finding

Every picture the code points at (app and notification icons, badges, manifest and share images): is it the current brand and in the form the platform needs (size, one colour where the system draws only an outline)?
An old-brand or wrong-form picture = finding
To follow taps, find the one place that handles a tapped notification and list the pages it knows
then list every kind of notification the code posts (on the phone and from the server) and check each kind is in that list
A save button greyed out because nothing changed yet counts too: the screen must say it is already saved

A promise that every look or change is recorded: routes that skip the app's code (the database's own login, its table editor, admin tools) leave no code to read, so look for a record the database itself writes (an audit setting, a job that pulls its logs)
none = finding
